subject.component: Git patch extraction and local cost calculation

workload.description: 30 newest commits at the subject revision, 2216592 bytes of canonical patches, Claude local approximation. No provider inference calls.
workload.method: Linux perf_counter wall time, RUSAGE_SELF plus RUSAGE_CHILDREN CPU time, process peak RSS. Median of nine samples for parse, fixed-patch calculation and the complete pipeline.
workload.warmup: One full pass per scenario before the nine measured samples. Each variant runs in a fresh Python process with the same environment and harness.

controls.mechanism: Explicit commit ceiling and 20 MB workload rejection, no recursive filesystem scan
controls.verification: Benchmark argument validation and recorded patch byte count

controls.mechanism: One sequential Git show per group of at most 16 selected commits
controls.verification: Batched patches equal individual reads across batch boundaries

controls.mechanism: Synchronous bounded groups, no worker pool or pending task queue
controls.verification: Source review and pipeline regression tests

controls.mechanism: LRU by model name, immutable encoding mapping for process lifetime, eviction or process restart invalidates, no source text or credentials cached
controls.verification: Bounded cache declaration and local tokenizer tests

controls.mechanism: Measured memory acceptance gate before accepting the local candidate
controls.verification: Candidate peak RSS does not exceed baseline

invariants.verification: tests/test_git_parser.py compares root, merge, rename, deletion, binary and batched diffs with Git
tests/test_calculation.py verifies exact small costs, zero work, invalid inputs and rounding after aggregation
Existing result keys remain, new estimation and diff_stats fields are additive, documented corrections are checked by regression tests
Provider clients are forbidden in local estimation tests and external Git diff and textconv helpers are disabled
benchmarks/check_performance.py verifies measured CPU and memory budgets and evidence identity
Local changes authorized by the user, no deployment, publication or shared repository mutation

strategy.rationale: Profiled Git startup and native tokenization dominate runtime. Reduce Git calls, eliminate duplicate diff scans and failed SDK initialization without adding parallel work.
strategy.compatibility: Preserve existing API fields and filter order. Correct root patches, literal plus and minus lines, model encodings and aliases, zero costs, aggregation rounding and finite ROI formatting. Add estimation metadata. See regression tests.

rollout.mechanism: Local source candidate with regression suite and benchmark budget gate
rollout.scope: Local calculator and Git parser, 30 commit measurement fixture
rollout.abortThreshold: Any regression test or declared performance budget failure

rollback.mechanism: Restore only the implementation paths from the subject revision and rerun the same workload
rollback.scope: Five changed implementation files, preserve unrelated user changes and evidence
rollback.abortThreshold: Functional tests fail or baseline workload identity changes
